From: Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.com>

Cc: ShowBuild Logistics <ops@showbuild.com>, Acme Print Co <orders@acmeprint.com>, Sierra Park - Venue Coord <sierra.park@moscone.com>
Date: 2028-07-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Kickoff: split-stage demo rotation & supply triage

Team,

Quick kickoff note for CloudCon West — we landed the split-stage footprint (see attached floorplan) which means we will have two demo pedestals on a rotating schedule (30 min blocks) and a small presenter area that needs rapid changeover. Major asks:

- ShowBuild: confirm crate rotation plan (we need a fast swap procedure for pedestal A/B). Can you price a two-person crew for swap windows and list required access lanes?
- Acme Print: confirm banner + quick-swap magnetic face specs — we need 6 sets (2 per pedestal, 2 spare) and 48" quick-change headers.
- Ops (Marissa/Logan): we need a triage table for spare batteries, mics, dongles, and a labeled crate map. Can you confirm who will own the triage table during exhibit hours?
- Stephanie/Laura: estimate for PO / vendor payment timeline — we need deposits to lock the crew by 2028-08-10.

I attached a first-pass floorplan (split-stage_floorplan_v1.pdf) and a preliminary ShowBuild quote placeholder. Let's keep threads short — replies inline with bullet answers.

Thanks — Ethan

--
Ethan Park
Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
ethan_park@redwood.com | (415) 555-0187

From: ShowBuild Logistics <ops@showbuild.com>
To: Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Sierra Park - Venue Coord <sierra.park@moscone.com>, Acme Print Co <orders@acmeprint.com>
Date: 2028-07-30T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: split-stage demo rotation & supply triage

Ethan / team,

Thanks for the brief. We can support a two-person swap crew for the rotation windows. Notes and ask below:

- Crew: 2x technicians during swap windows, 1x on-site lead entire day (crew rate attached in showbuild_quote_0828.xlsx).
- Swap procedure: technicians need a 6' clear access lane on the aisle side and the dock-side crate swap (we propose staging crates at Dock 4).
- Timing: to do clean swaps in under 5 minutes we recommend a single dedicated triage table + one labeled rolling crate per pedestal.
- Power: both pedestals need independent power strips with surge and 8' cable runs.

Attached: showbuild_quote_0828.xlsx and a mark-up of your floorplan with suggested crate staging points.

Quick clarification: are demos pulling a persistent KV cache on the hosts (i.e., are we swapping live hardware with state)? That affects how quickly the swap can happen.

Regards,
Maya Rivera
Operations Lead | ShowBuild Logistics
ops@showbuild.com | (720) 555-3991
[attachment: showbuild_quote_0828.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: ShowBuild Logistics <ops@showbuild.com>, Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Print Co <orders@acmeprint.com>, Sierra Park - Venue Coord <sierra.park@moscone.com>
Date: 2028-07-31T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: split-stage demo rotation & supply triage

Thanks Maya — helpful. Quick answers inline: 

- Ethan: demos will NOT be live-swapped with stateful KV caches. We will run isolated instances per pedestal so hardware swaps are cold-swaps (no state migration). That should cut down swap time.
- Logan & I will own the triage table staffing during exhibitor hours. We'll split shifts (Logan 9–1, Marissa 1–5).
- Crate staging at Dock 4 is fine — I'll add a color-coded map to the Drive folder.
- Power: logistics note — venue requires NEMA power drops requests 14 days out; Sierra, can you confirm the drop schedule and any constraints for Dock 4?

Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Senior Events Producer | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0222
[attachment: split-stage_floorplan_v1.pdf (pdf)]
